answer.summary: E2E failed because the openaev-app container crashed at startup with a duplicate Flyway migration version. This PR adds V6_20261118120000000__Catalog_connector_injector_contracts.java, and the log reports the same version already used by V6_20261118120000000__Request_finding_refeed_for_asset_groups_side. The failure is deterministic, so a rerun will fail the same way. Give the new migration a unique version number.

evidence.quote: Caused by: java.lang.IllegalStateException: Duplicate Flyway migration version found: V6_20261118120000000__Request_finding_refeed_for_asset_groups_side.class
